title: Complete Massage Overview
summary: An overview of basic movement directions, body areas, and the sequence of a general massage.
goal: Use this card as a navigation map for the guide's sections and individual techniques.
imageAlt: Infographic showing basic massage techniques and body areas.
startingPosition: Open an individual technique for the body area you want to work on and follow its instructions.
instructions: Use this card as a general navigation overview.
Open individual techniques by body area for practical guidance.
Follow the pressure and safety notes provided for each technique.
direction: Movement direction depends on the selected technique and body area.
tips: Start with gentle techniques and progress gradually.
Use the receiver's comfort as the primary guide.
mistakes: Using the overview instead of the instructions for a specific technique.
Ignoring pain, inflammation, or damaged skin.
warning: This overview is not individualized medical advice.
telegramCaption: A basic map of massage areas and techniques. Detailed techniques are available in the PWA.
